fc_bracket.what: x -67..-64, y -74..-37, z 13.5..59.5 behind the right arm, four dia 2.5 holes on the flange bosses
fc_bracket.purpose: carries the FC + ESC stack behind the right arm
fc_bracket.simpler: stack on the arm web: no room in front (battery, saddle)

fc_bracket.what: four dia 7 x 4 bosses on the 30.5 pattern centred (y -56, z 40), dia 2.9 M3 pilots through
fc_bracket.purpose: male ends of four M3 x 6 M-F nylon standoffs screw in (hand-turned); the ESC (1.6 board, 6 mm overall, maker drawing) sits on them; four M3 x 8 M-F nylon spacers go male end through the ESC into the standoffs and give an 8 mm board gap (ESC top parts 4.4 mm + FC underside about 2 mm + 1.6 spare; the FC manual gives 36 x 36 x 8 and no spacer length, so 8 mm is derived); the FC on its grommets is held by four M3 x 8 nylon screws into the spacers' female ends (the chain ends female, so the brief's nylon nuts have no thread to sit on)
fc_bracket.simpler: M3 screws from the front: heads would sit in the closed bay
fc_bracket.validation: fit_check fcb-m3-*; access stack step (fc-screw-0..3, 0 blocked)
fc_bracket.change_when: board pattern or board heights change on arrival

fc_bracket.purpose: harness and right battery leads from the bay into the 10 mm gap under the ESC
fc_bracket.simpler: leads round the plate edge: the plate fills the bay rear
fc_bracket.validation: 2.5 mm to the lower screw holes

fc_bracket.what: x -102..-64, y -72..-46, z 13.5..17.5 with four dia 2.15 pilots for the MTF-01 (centre x -86, y -59), module under it lens down
fc_bracket.purpose: flow + range module at the right rear behind the leg sweep, 42 deg cone downward
fc_bracket.simpler: module on the arm bottom: legs pass under x > -70
fc_bracket.validation: cone check against the pose clouds
